title: Audit versioned GPL570 probe-to-gene mappings
question: Which GPL570 probes map ambiguously to genes, and what annotation version is defensible for the public microarray reproduction?
scope: Source and mapping-method review, not a ranked biological target discovery.
steps: Identify annotation source, genome/probe release, download terms and unannotated or multiply mapped probes.
Specify a reproducible gene-aggregation or probe-reporting policy before looking at candidate significance.
Document ambiguity without promoting a nearest gene to a causal target.
deliverables: A source-linked annotation policy and version record under docs/research-notes/.
A small synthetic test fixture for any new mapping helper; no patient expression matrix.
acceptance: Ambiguous and unmapped probes remain identifiable rather than being silently dropped.
The selected release and mapping decisions can be reconstructed from sources.
The report makes no novel target or clinical claims.
